name: motion-reading-hold
title: Reading Hold
description: Bài học: chữ phải đứng yên ít nhất max(0.7 s, 0.25 s + số ký tự / 17), cộng 0.25 giây cho mỗi từ.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio t-read, written here): Three short words cycle every 1330 ms: fade in 133 ms, hold, fade out 133 ms; a progress bar fills over each word and turns accent after 75 %. Rule: hold text at least max(0.70 s, 0.25 s + chars / 17), +0.25 s per word; even short phrases over 1 s. Recipe: enter 300 ms, hold, exit 200 ms. Params: min (0.7 s) · chars_per_s (17) · per_word (0.25 s). Hold text at least max(0.7 s, 0.25 s + characters / 17), plus 0.25 s a word; even short phrases over 1 s.
